name: Calling Someone Names
overview: Scripture reveals that the words we speak have profound power, capable of either harming or healing others. Calling someone names reflects a destructive tongue, likened to a sword that wounds, whereas the wise use their speech to bring health and peace. A man lacking wisdom despises his neighbor with harsh words, but the understanding person exercises restraint, knowing that life and death reside in the tongue's power. Therefore, ceasing from strife and responding softly honors God and promotes harmony among believers.
